document:11:551:0.text:
I, Rowan of the Mithril Consortium, hereby make this formal declaration:
In the Grand Royal Supreme Card Tournament today, I suffered an unfortunate (and likely arranged) defeat at the hands of Princess Peggy.
I accept the loss and, of my own free will, shall unconditionally serve as Princess Peggy's errand boy for one day at any time she chooses in the future.

My duties shall include, but not limited to:
Carry bags (up to 10 kg).
Pay bills (only reasonable amounts and items).
Compliment Princess Peggy's wisdom and beauty whenever necessary (even if I don't mean it).

This serves as formal proof of my pledge.
<align="right">Debtor: Rowan (shaky signature)
<align="right">Creditor: Peggy (smug signature)

本人，秘银商会罗万在此郑重承诺：
因在今日的“皇家至尊无敌超级纸牌大赛”中，不幸（且极有可能是被针对地）败给了佩吉公主。
本人愿赌服输，自愿在未来任意一天的任意时刻，无条件响应佩吉公主的召唤，并担任其专属跟班一日。
跟班职责包括但不限于：
拎包（限重10公斤以内）。
买单（仅限合理的金额和商品范围内）。
在佩吉公主需要的时候，大声赞美她的智慧与美貌（可以违心地说）。
特此立据，绝不赖账！
<align="right">欠债人：罗万（颤抖的签名）
<align="right">债权人：佩吉（得意洋洋的签名）

say:13:1720714012:1.text: Alright, I'm good to go. As a man of my word, I'll accompany you for the day.

say:11:1720717009:0.source_cn: 唉……好好好，我给，我给就是了。

say:7:1720734005:1.source_cn: ……佩吉，世界很大，光鲜亮丽只是它的一面。阴影和苦难，...

say:8:1720734006:1.source_cn: 而且……你看到的这些，还不是全部。

say:9:1720734007:1.source_cn: 还不是全部？那……还有什么？

say:10:1720734008:1.text: I wish to learn more about Savannah... and my people. I want to understand both their joy and their sorrows...
say:10:1720734008:1.source_cn: ……我想更加了解赛凡纳，了解我生活的这片土地，了解……...

say:11:1720734009:1.text: Peggy's eyes gleam with determination, yet you know she still has a long way to go before she can truly understand Savannah and the empire.

say:11:1720734009:1.female: Peggy's eyes gleam with determination, yet you know she still has a long way to go before she can truly understand Savannah and the empire.

say:15:1720734012:1.text: I'm ready. I'm making the most of my time outside to see the world as it truly is.
say:15:1720734012:1.source_cn: 好，带我去。既然我已经从王宫走了出来，我就要看清楚这个...

say:0:1720735001:1.text: Julino, I've come to see you again.

say:1:1720736001:1.text: Is that elderly lady mourning a loved one? She looks so sad... What can we do to help her?
say:1:1720736001:1.source_cn: 那位老妇人……她是在祭奠逝去的亲人吗？她看起来很伤心的...

say:2:1720736002:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Rowan, how about we pick some roses for her? Those beautiful flowers might lift her spirits.
say:2:1720736002:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Rowan, how about we pick some roses for her? Those beautiful flowers might lift her spirits.
say:2:1720736002:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Rowan, how about we pick some roses for her? Those beautiful flowers might lift her spirits.

say:1:1720737001:0.text: These petals look vibrant and flawless... Let's make a bouquet!
say:1:1720737001:0.source_cn: 颜色一尘不染，花瓣也没有一点瑕疵……就选这一束吧！

say:2:1720737002:1.text: But the bouquet looks a bit plain right now... According to the royal florist, a bouquet needs some leaves, proper trimming, and a matching ribbon to really come to life...
say:2:1720737002:1.source_cn: 可是花束的花杆光秃秃的不太好看……王宫里的花艺老师讲过...

say:3:1720737003:1.text: Drawing on the art of floral arrangement she learned at the palace, Peggy transforms the white roses into an exquisite bouquet.
say:3:1720737003:1.source_cn: 佩吉用她学到的宫廷插花术，将采集来的白玫瑰精心搭配成了...

say:4:1720737004:1.text: Perfect! I'm sure the flowers will cheer her up!
say:4:1720737004:1.source_cn: 看！这样就漂亮多了！这么美的花束，一定能让她好受一些。

say:5:1720737005:1.source_cn: 走吧，我们这就去送给她！

say:2:1720738001:1.text: Madam, I'm sorry for your loss. This bouquet is for you.
say:2:1720738001:1.source_cn: 夫人，请节哀。这是……这是我为您准备的花。

say:4:1720738003:1.text: Yes, I hope it brings you solace.
say:4:1720738003:1.source_cn: 是的。希望能带给您一丝慰藉。

say:5:1720738004:1.text: I appreciate your kindness, young lady, but this bouquet is... a little too fancy.
say:5:1720738004:1.source_cn: 谢谢你的好意，小姑娘。但这花……太华丽了。

say:6:1720738005:0.text: It'd fit well on a dressing table or in a crystal vase in the palace, but not before a grave.
say:6:1720738005:0.source_cn: 它适合摆在铺着天鹅绒桌布的梳妆台上，或者插在王宫的水晶...

say:7:1720738006:0.text: Because its brightness only deepens the gloom of this grave.
say:7:1720738006:0.source_cn: 放在坟墓前的话，只会让这冰冷的墓碑看起来更加凄凉吧。

say:9:1720738008:1.text: My son, Julino, lost his life in the Divine War twenty years ago.
say:9:1720738008:1.source_cn: 我的儿子朱利诺，是在二十年前的那场神魔大战中牺牲的。

say:10:1720738009:1.text: He was still so young when he left for the battlefield to protect Savannah...
say:10:1720738009:1.source_cn: 那时候，他还那么年轻，为了保护身后的赛凡纳，他义无反顾...

say:11:1720738010:1.text: But now... no one remembers him, nor the other young souls who perished in the war. Everyone celebrates Savannah's prosperity at the festival, yet they forget what it cost.
say:11:1720738010:1.source_cn: 可是现在，还有谁记得他？还有谁记得那些像他一样死去的孩...

say:12:1720738011:1.text: I have no need for such lovely flowers, young lady. I only wish one more person would remember what my son sacrificed for Savannah.
say:12:1720738011:1.source_cn: 姑娘，我不需要这些漂亮的花。我只想让多一个人知道，曾经...

say:14:1720738013:1.text: Sorry, madam... Thank you for sharing this with me. Julino... I'll keep that name in mind.
say:14:1720738013:1.source_cn: 对不起……夫人。还有，谢谢你告诉我这些。我会把朱利诺这...

choice_prompt:15:1720738013.text: Sorry, madam... Thank you for sharing this with me. Julino... I'll keep that name in mind.
choice_prompt:15:1720738013.source_cn: 对不起……夫人。还有，谢谢你告诉我这些。我会把朱利诺这个名字记在心里的。

say:16:1720738014:2.text: We should go. Let's give the lady some time alone with her son...
say:16:1720738014:2.source_cn: 佩吉，我们走吧。让她和朱利诺……单独待一会儿。

say:2:1720739001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Rowan, be honest with me—am I failing as a princess?
say:2:1720739001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Rowan, be honest with me—am I failing as a princess?

say:3:1720739002:1.text: W-Where did that come from? I mean, you can be childish and annoying at times... but you do have your strengths.
say:3:1720739002:1.source_cn: 你、你怎么突然这么说？虽然你平时总是很幼稚，无理取闹，...

say:4:1720739003:1.text: For example, you did great today, so don't be so hard on yourself!
say:4:1720739003:1.source_cn: 像今天你就做得很不错啊，哪有你说的那么糟糕！

say:5:1720739004:1.text: But... nothing I do seems to make any difference. The children are still without a home, the minstrel's talent still goes unrecognized, and that lady... I couldn't make her feel better at all.
say:5:1720739004:1.source_cn: 可是……我什么都改变不了。那些孩子依然没有家，诗人的才...

say:6:1720739005:1.text: ... Just like what happened with Orion. I didn't realize what was happening until it was too late to help.
say:6:1720739005:1.source_cn: ……就像哥哥的事一样。我总是后知后觉，什么也没发现，什...

choice_prompt:7:1720739005.text: ... Just like what happened with Orion. I didn't realize what was happening until it was too late to help.
choice_prompt:7:1720739005.source_cn: ……就像哥哥的事一样。我总是后知后觉，什么也没发现，什么也做不了，只能眼睁睁看着他离开。

say:8:1720739006:1.text: No! It's my fault! I should've understood how my brother felt... I was too easily manipulated, and I should've seen through his lies...
say:8:1720739006:1.source_cn: 不！是我的错！如果我能早点察觉到哥哥的心情，如果我不是...

say:9:1720739007:1.text: If I had stopped him in time, things wouldn't have come to this...
say:9:1720739007:1.source_cn: 说不定我还能来得及阻止哥哥，我们也不会走到现在这一步……

say:10:1720739008:1.text: I thought I could bring happiness to the people just like my parents, but I'm nowhere close... Would things have turned out differently if I were more mature and wiser?
say:10:1720739008:1.source_cn: 我以为我能像父王和母后那样为赛凡纳的人民带来幸福，但现...

say:11:1720739009:1.text: If only I had done more...
say:11:1720739009:1.source_cn: 归根结底……都怪我太幼稚了，太没用了……

choice_prompt:12:1720739009.text: If only I had done more...
choice_prompt:12:1720739009.source_cn: 归根结底……都怪我太幼稚了，太没用了……

say:13:1720739010:1.text: It's a responsibility I must bear as a princess. It's just that I've always been sheltered, living under my family's protection.
say:13:1720739010:1.source_cn: 可是我是耀光的公主，这是我本来就应该承担的责任。只是一...

say:14:1720739011:1.text: And I haven't lived up to my duty.
say:14:1720739011:1.source_cn: 我，不是一个尽责的公主。

say:15:1720739012:1.text: Peggy, even your parents didn't start out knowing it all. You're already doing your best...
say:15:1720739012:1.source_cn: 佩吉，就连国王和王后，也不是生来就无所不能的。你已经在...

say:16:1720739013:1.text: Right now, what you need most is rest. You'll feel better tomorrow after a good night's sleep.
say:16:1720739013:1.source_cn: 你需要回宫好好休息，睡一觉，明天心情会变好的。

say:17:1720739014:1.text: Maybe... but right now, I don't know if I can still be that bright, cheerful Princess Peggy tomorrow. Is that really who I am?
say:17:1720739014:1.source_cn: 也许吧。但是现在……我真的不知道该怎么面对明天那个穿着...

say:18:1720739015:1.text: I could use some time out here... to figure out how to be a good princess.
say:18:1720739015:1.source_cn: 我想在外面再待一阵子，好好想想……该怎么做个合格的公主。

say:19:1720739016:1.text: Very well... Since I'm still your errand boy, I'll go along with whatever you say.
say:19:1720739016:1.source_cn: 好吧，毕竟现在，你还是我名义上的债主嘛。你说的话，我只...

say:0:1720740001:0.text: I can spend the night at the Royal Guard base. Gwyneth will let me stay.
say:0:1720740001:0.source_cn: 我们去守备军驻地吧，格温妮丝一定会收留我的。

say:3:1720742001:1.source_cn: 佩吉，怎么样，今天玩得开心吗？

say:4:1720742002:1.text: It was alright... I made new friends and gained some fresh perspectives...
say:4:1720742002:1.source_cn: 还可以吧……我认识了新朋友，也知道了很多以前不知道的事……

say:5:1720742003:1.text: Gwyneth... can I stay with you tonight? I... don't feel like going back to the palace just yet.
say:5:1720742003:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝……我今晚能不能和你住一起？我……我还不想回宫。

say:6:1720742004:1.text: Sure thing. I'm on duty tonight, though, so you'll have to make do with my tent. As for the palace...
say:6:1720742004:1.source_cn: 当然可以，只不过今天轮到我值勤，只能委屈你挤一挤我的营...

choice_prompt:7:1720742004.text: Sure thing. I'm on duty tonight, though, so you'll have to make do with my tent. As for the palace...
choice_prompt:7:1720742004.source_cn: 当然可以，只不过今天轮到我值勤，只能委屈你挤一挤我的营帐了。只是王宫那边……

say:8:1720742005:1.source_cn: 那就麻烦您了，梅林阁下。

say:10:1720742007:1.text: *Yawn* I should head back and get some rest. Honestly, being your errand boy is more exhausting than running the Consortium, Peggy...
say:10:1720742007:1.source_cn: 呼，我也得回去好好休息了，做佩吉你的跟班可比工作累多了……

say:2:1720745001:1.source_cn: 还在纠结呢？还记得昨天的苏珊婆婆吧，她可是很期待你戴上...

say:3:1720745002:1.source_cn: 我知道啦……我也不想让她失望。我只是想到，要面对那么多...

say:3:1720746001:1.text: "Guidance of the dawn"... "Insight and wisdom beyond his years"...
say:3:1720746001:1.source_cn: “破晓的指引”……“超越凡俗岁月的洞察与智慧……”

say:4:1720746002:1.text: Wisdom Spell... Th-This is just what I need! A spell that can make me wiser overnight!
say:4:1720746002:1.source_cn: 这、这不就是我现在最需要的吗？！一夜长大的魔法！心智升...

say:5:1720746003:1.text: Can we even confirm if it's true? Peggy, do you know which king this is about?
say:5:1720746003:1.source_cn: 这上面写的……是真的吗？佩吉，你知道这是哪位国王的事迹吗？

say:6:1720746004:1.text: How would I know? I barely pay attention in history class...
say:6:1720746004:1.source_cn: 我的历史课都没怎么好好听，怎么可能会知道……

say:7:1720746005:1.text: But I'm familiar with these relics. My parents and history teacher have mentioned them before... I believe they're real.
say:7:1720746005:1.source_cn: 不过这些王室遗物的名字，我的确听过不止一次，父王、母后...

say:8:1720746006:1.text: It says here that the entrance to the Land of Bones, where the four relics are hidden, only opens under special circumstances.
say:8:1720746006:1.source_cn: 从文字描述来看，通往遗骨之地的大门只有在特殊情况下才会...

say:9:1720746007:1.text: It doesn't explain how the relics are obtained, but I'm certain the trial won't be easy.
say:9:1720746007:1.source_cn: 虽然不知道取得遗物的过程是怎样的，但既然提到了试炼，过...

say:10:1720746008:1.text: Where could the entrance be? "Where candlelight and shadow became one"... what does that mean?
say:10:1720746008:1.source_cn: 可是那扇大门会在哪呢？“于烛火与阴影交织之处”，这会是...

say:11:1720746009:1.text: "Beneath the chamber drapes"... "Where candlelight and shadow became one"... I've got it! It's Father's chamber!
say:11:1720746009:1.source_cn: “在寝殿的帷幔阴影中”……“于烛火与阴影交织之处”……...

say:12:1720746010:1.text: When I was little, I accidentally triggered some kind of switch there. A passage opened, leading me into the Hall of Ancients. But... what happened after that?
say:12:1720746010:1.source_cn: 小时候我在寝殿里玩的时候，不知道碰到了什么机关，顺着一...

say:13:1720746011:1.text: Ah, I remember bumping into a candlestick before the passage opened! That must be the switch!
say:13:1720746011:1.source_cn: 现在回想起来，我当时碰到的就是寝殿里的烛台！原来……原...

say:14:1720746012:1.text: I thought of using that passage to escape the Hall of Ancients last time, but I never got the chance...
say:14:1720746012:1.source_cn: 上次我被困在圣古堂的时候，原本就想利用那条密道走出去的...

say:15:1720746013:1.text: The Hall of Ancients has to be the Land of Bones, then. And frankly, given what's in the chapel, it's a fitting name.
say:15:1720746013:1.source_cn: 既然那条密道连通寝殿与圣古堂，也就是说，记载里提到的遗...

say:16:1720746014:1.text: Should we head straight to the Hall of Ancients?
say:16:1720746014:1.source_cn: 这样一来的话，我们岂不是可以直接去圣古堂寻找遗物？

say:17:1720746015:1.text: Hmm... Although I've heard of those relics, I had no idea they were kept in the Hall of Ancients, and I saw no sign of them when I was trapped there...
say:17:1720746015:1.source_cn: 奇怪，我只听说过这些遗物的名字，却从来没听说过它们被存...

say:18:1720746016:1.text: Maybe this isn't as simple as we thought. According to the records, the king only found the path to the Land of Bones after his "silent prayer" was answered.
say:18:1720746016:1.source_cn: 或许没有我们想的这么简单。记载里提到，这位王是在“无声...

say:19:1720746017:1.text: The Land of Bones could be an otherworldly space, unlocked only by those with a strong will...
say:19:1720746017:1.source_cn: 说不定所谓的遗骨之地是一处异空间，只有怀着强烈的愿望启...

say:20:1720746018:1.text: I-I was just taking a guess! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?
say:20:1720746018:1.male: I-I was just taking a guess! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?
say:20:1720746018:1.female: I-I was just taking a guess! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?

choice_prompt:21:1720746018.male: I-I was just taking a guess! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?
choice_prompt:21:1720746018.female: I-I was just taking a guess! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think?

say:22:1720746019:1.text: This is an opportunity I must take! If I can overcome the trial, I'll grow wise just like my ancestor! I need to do this for my parents and the people of Savannah!
say:22:1720746019:1.source_cn: 不管怎样，我要试一试！如果我能通过试炼，我就能像那位先...

say:23:1720746020:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm heading back to the palace now. I'm going to enter the Land of Bones and get all four relics!
say:23:1720746020:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm heading back to the palace now. I'm going to enter the Land of Bones and get all four relics!
say:23:1720746020:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm heading back to the palace now. I'm going to enter the Land of Bones and get all four relics!

choice_prompt:24:1720746020.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，我决定了，我要现在就回宫！我要去开启那个机关，找齐那四件遗物！
choice_prompt:24:1720746020.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm heading back to the palace now. I'm going to enter the Land of Bones and get all four relics!
choice_prompt:24:1720746020.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm heading back to the palace now. I'm going to enter the Land of Bones and get all four relics!

choice:24:0:1.text: Looks like you're ready to go back.
choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 看来你已经准备好回王宫了
choice:24:0:1.male: Looks like you're ready to go back.
choice:24:0:1.female: Looks like you're ready to go back.

choice:24:1:2.text: Let me lift the shapeshifting spell for you.
choice:24:1:2.source_cn: 那么，我帮你解除幻化魔法
choice:24:1:2.male: Let me lift the shapeshifting spell for you.
choice:24:1:2.female: Let me lift the shapeshifting spell for you.

say:3:1720747001:1.text: This time, I'll rely on myself to get stronger!
say:3:1720747001:1.source_cn: 本公主振作起来了！这一次，我要靠自己去赢得力量！

say:4:1720747002:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Rowan, and Gwyneth... you don't have to come with me.
say:4:1720747002:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Rowan, and Gwyneth... you don't have to come with me.
say:4:1720747002:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Rowan, and Gwyneth... you don't have to come with me.

say:5:1720747003:1.text: This is a challenge I must undertake on my own. If I bring you all along, it would defeat the purpose.
say:5:1720747003:1.source_cn: 既然是试炼，那就必须由我自己去面对。带上你们，就不算数了！

say:6:1720747004:1.text: W-What are you talking about? How could you push me away at a time like this?
say:6:1720747004:1.source_cn: 你、你在说什么傻话……怎么能在即将面对危险的时候把我甩开！

say:7:1720747005:1.text: ... Since I promised to be your errand boy for a full day, I'll see it through!
say:7:1720747005:1.source_cn: ……契约书上白纸黑字写着，我要当一整天的跟班，昨天满打...

say:8:1720747006:1.text: Even King Rolan had knights like Reinhold, Rion, and Ryan at his side when he took to the battlefield.
say:8:1720747006:1.source_cn: 即便是初代国王罗兰大帝御驾亲征，身边也有雷吉纳德、莱恩...

say:9:1720747007:1.text: Peggy, as a member of the Royal Guard and also a knight, escorting you is my duty and honor.
say:9:1720747007:1.source_cn: 佩吉，身为皇家守备军，身为一名骑士，护卫你是我的职责，...

choice_prompt:10:1720747007.text: Peggy, as a member of the Royal Guard and also a knight, escorting you is my duty and honor.
choice_prompt:10:1720747007.source_cn: 佩吉，身为皇家守备军，身为一名骑士，护卫你是我的职责，也是我的荣耀。

say:11:1720747008:1.text: Fine, you can come! I just can't win against any of you!
say:11:1720747008:1.source_cn: 好啦好啦！真是拿你们没办法！

say:12:1720747009:1.text: Just so you know, I won't wait if any of you can't keep up!
say:12:1720747009:1.source_cn: 那你们可要跟紧了！本公主的步伐可是很快的，掉队了我可不管！

say:13:1720747010:1.source_cn: 遵命……步伐很快的公主殿下。

choice:10:0:1.text: I need to find out if the tale is true.
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 我需要验证秘闻是否真实
choice:10:0:1.male: I need to find out if the tale is true.
choice:10:0:1.female: I need to find out if the tale is true.

choice:10:1:2.text: I have to be there as a witness.
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 作为见证者，我也得在场
choice:10:1:2.male: I have to be there as a witness.
choice:10:1:2.female: I have to be there as a witness.

say:0:1720749001:0.text: Perfect timing! I don't have to explain what I'm doing!
say:0:1720749001:0.source_cn: 母后陪父王散步去了，好机会！这样就不用和父王解释了！

say:0:1720750001:0.text: I think that odd candlestick is... over here.
say:0:1720750001:0.source_cn: 那个奇怪的烛台……好像在这边。

say:0:1720751001:0.text: It really opens up the passage!

say:0:1720752001:0.text: There are statues guarding this place? Looks like the trial has begun!
say:0:1720752001:0.source_cn: 有魔法盔甲在这里看守？看来试炼开始了！

say:2:1720753001:1.text: Ha, I knew it! This really is part of the trial!
say:2:1720753001:1.source_cn: 看！我就知道！这果然是试炼的一部分！

say:3:1720753002:1.text: Tsk, those two big guys are all bark and no bite! I didn't even go all out!
say:3:1720753002:1.source_cn: 那两个大家伙虽然看起来吓人，但也就是看着唬人罢了！本公...

say:4:1720753003:1.text: Peggy, don't let your guard down. This is just the beginning, and the real challenge may be yet to come.
say:4:1720753003:1.source_cn: 佩吉，不要大意。这只是开始，真正的危险可能还在后面。

say:5:1720753004:1.text: Let's press on! Nothing can stop me from getting the relics!
say:5:1720753004:1.source_cn: 继续前进吧！无论里面有什么，我都一定要拿到那四件遗物！

say:0:1720754001:0.text: The Hall of Ancients feels different from before...
say:0:1720754001:0.source_cn: 这里果然是圣古堂！但气氛和之前不太一样了……

say:1:1720754002:0.source_cn: 我们仔细找找有没有遗物的线索吧。

say:0:1720755001:0.text: Look! That box wasn't there before!
say:0:1720755001:0.source_cn: 看！那边有个之前从来没出现过的匣子！

say:1:1720755002:0.text: That mechanism should get us across.
say:1:1720755002:0.source_cn: 利用那个机关应该可以传送到对面。
say:1:1720755002:0.male: That mechanism should get us across.
say:1:1720755002:0.female: That mechanism should get us across.

say:0:1720756001:0.text: Ah, I see! We can reach that box from here!
say:0:1720756001:0.source_cn: 从这一侧就可以前往匣子所在的位置了，我明白了！

say:3:1720757002:1.text: This quill looks just like any other... Are you sure it's a royal relic?
say:3:1720757002:1.source_cn: 这看起来就是一支普通的羽毛笔……这真的是王室遗物之一吗？

say:4:1720757003:1.text: Absolutely! My etiquette teacher told me it was crafted from a griffin feather that King Rolan himself plucked, which makes it extraordinarily valuable.
say:4:1720757003:1.source_cn: 当然！我想起来了，礼仪课上老师特意讲过，传说这支笔的羽...

say:5:1720757004:1.text: And King Rolan used it to sign the Lightbearer Code!
say:5:1720757004:1.source_cn: 但它被作为王室遗物不是因为羽毛的珍贵，而是因为，这是罗...

say:6:1720757005:0.text: It also graced the rulings that condemned criminals, pardoned the innocent, and decrees that led the empire toward a brighter future...
say:6:1720757005:0.source_cn: 它曾经审判过最凶恶的罪犯，也赦免过最无辜的平民，更签署...

choice_prompt:7:1720757005.text: It also graced the rulings that condemned criminals, pardoned the innocent, and decrees that led the empire toward a brighter future...
choice_prompt:7:1720757005.source_cn: 它曾经审判过最凶恶的罪犯，也赦免过最无辜的平民，更签署了无数为耀光带来美好未来的承诺书……

say:8:1720757006:1.text: For some reason, seeing the quill jogs my memory of all those dry facts...
say:8:1720757006:1.source_cn: 不知道为什么，看到它，那些好不容易背下又很快忘记的句子...

say:9:1720757007:1.text: Three more to go! Let's keep the momentum going!
say:9:1720757007:1.source_cn: 还有三件遗物，我们一鼓作气把它们找齐吧！

choice:7:1:2.text: Guess you weren't dozing off the whole time.
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 看来你并没有都在打瞌睡
choice:7:1:2.male: Guess you weren't dozing off the whole time.
choice:7:1:2.female: Guess you weren't dozing off the whole time.

say:0:1720758001:0.text: This path... it was blocked by statues before, but now it's clear.
say:0:1720758001:0.source_cn: 这条路……之前在圣古堂的时候被雕像拦住了，现在可以通行了。

say:0:1720760001:0.text: If I shoot it with <style="highlight">Spirit Shot</style>, I might be able to use it to teleport over there.
say:0:1720760001:0.source_cn: 这个锚点可以记录我的位置，用<style=highli...
say:0:1720760001:0.male: If I shoot it with <style="highlight">Spirit Shot</style>, I might be able to use it to teleport over there.
say:0:1720760001:0.female: If I shoot it with <style="highlight">Spirit Shot</style>, I might be able to use it to teleport over there.

say:1:1720763001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, now that all four relics are here, what do I have to do to activate the Wisdom Spell?
say:1:1720763001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, now that all four relics are here, what do I have to do to activate the Wisdom Spell?
say:1:1720763001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, now that all four relics are here, what do I have to do to activate the Wisdom Spell?

say:2:1720763002:1.text: Maybe there are other steps to follow...

narration:3:1720763003:1.text: Before you can speak, you sense a surge of magic swelling around you. A teleportation circle whisks you straight to the heart of the Hall of Ancients...
narration:3:1720763003:1.male: Before you can speak, you sense a surge of magic swelling around you. A teleportation circle whisks you straight to the heart of the Hall of Ancients...
narration:3:1720763003:1.female: Before you can speak, you sense a surge of magic swelling around you. A teleportation circle whisks you straight to the heart of the Hall of Ancients...

say:2:1720765001:1.text: Mother? What are you doing here?

say:3:1720765002:1.text: Either way, I've found all four royal relics! I'm about to unlock a spell that can make me grow wise overnight!
say:3:1720765002:1.source_cn: 不过这不重要！母后，您看！我做到了！我找到了传说中的四...

say:4:1720765003:1.text: The relics don't hold any magic, silly girl.
say:4:1720765003:1.source_cn: 傻孩子，真正的魔法，从来都不在遗物里。

say:5:1720765004:1.text: Take another look at what you're holding in your hands.
say:5:1720765004:1.source_cn: 再看一眼你手中握着的这些东西吧。

say:2:1720767001:0.text: W-What's happening? The Feather of Truth... has turned into an order slip for a brooch?
say:2:1720767001:0.source_cn: 这、这是怎么回事？真理之羽……变成了……一张胸针的提货单？

say:3:1720767002:1.text: Yes. Susan poured her heart and soul into making that brooch for you. Wearing it is a way of honoring her craft.
say:3:1720767002:1.source_cn: 是的，那是苏珊婆婆用尽心血为你制作的胸针。戴上它，既是...

say:4:1720767003:1.text: And the coin... is now a land deed?
say:4:1720767003:1.source_cn: 那这枚金币……变成了一张地契？

say:5:1720767004:1.text: It's for a land in the lower district, and you're now its owner.
say:5:1720767004:1.source_cn: 这是一块位于下城区的土地，你拥有这块土地的使用权。

say:6:1720767005:1.text: You can build an orphanage there and provide a shelter to the homeless children.
say:6:1720767005:1.source_cn: 如果在那里修建一座孤儿院的话，那些流浪的孩子，很快就会...

say:7:1720767006:0.text: Where's the harp? All I see is an invitation to the Royal Theater.
say:7:1720767006:0.source_cn: 竖琴变成了……皇家大剧院的邀请函？

say:8:1720767007:1.text: I heard you met a talented minstrel in need of a stage. With this invitation, he can perform at the Royal Theater and let his voice resound throughout Savannah.
say:8:1720767007:1.source_cn: 我听说，有一位才华横溢的吟游诗人需要一个舞台。拿着这张...

say:9:1720767008:1.text: Why did the crown become a floral wreath?
say:9:1720767008:1.source_cn: 那这个王冠……为什么变成了花环？

say:10:1720767009:1.text: At your age, I wish for you to hold onto your tender heart rather than let the crown harden you. Take this wreath, and honor the heroes who gave their lives for the empire.
say:10:1720767009:1.source_cn: 因为在你这个年纪，比起冰冷的王冠，作为母亲，我更希望你...

say:11:1720767010:1.text: Peggy, these are my birthday gifts for you. Do you like them?
say:11:1720767010:1.source_cn: 亲爱的女儿，这些就是我送你的生日礼物，你还喜欢吗？

say:12:1720767011:0.text: Mother, how did you know all this? ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it was you, wasn't it?!
say:12:1720767011:0.source_cn: 母后，你是怎么知道这些的？……难道说，是<style=...
say:12:1720767011:0.male: Mother, how did you know all this? ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it was you, wasn't it?!
say:12:1720767011:0.female: Mother, how did you know all this? ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it was you, wasn't it?!

choice_prompt:13:1720767011.text: Mother, how did you know all this? ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it was you, wasn't it?!
choice_prompt:13:1720767011.source_cn: 母后，你是怎么知道这些的？……难道说，是<style=stress><player_name></style>！
choice_prompt:13:1720767011.male: Mother, how did you know all this? ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it was you, wasn't it?!
choice_prompt:13:1720767011.female: Mother, how did you know all this? ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it was you, wasn't it?!

say:14:1720767012:1.text: So, this is the Wisdom Spell...
say:14:1720767012:1.source_cn: 原来……这就是一夜长大的魔法……

say:15:1720767013:1.text: I see... There are no shortcuts on the road to wisdom. I must learn as I go, finding my own way to care for others and make the world a better place... right?
say:15:1720767013:1.source_cn: 没有捷径，也没有奇迹，只是不断去摸索，用更好的方式去关...

say:16:1720767014:1.text: Yes, and you've already done it, Peggy. Don't you think you're now a better princess than you were yesterday?
say:16:1720767014:1.source_cn: 是的，我的女儿，你已经做到了。看看现在的你，难道不比昨...

say:17:1720767015:1.text: ... Mother, I understand now! I'll attend the banquet!
say:17:1720767015:1.source_cn: ……母后，我明白了！我会回去参加宴会的！

say:18:1720767016:1.text: But... I have a small request.
say:18:1720767016:1.source_cn: 不过……关于我的生日宴会，我有个小小的请求，您能答应我吗？

say:19:1720767017:1.text: What is it? Whatever you wish, I'll grant it.
say:19:1720767017:1.source_cn: 当然，只要是你希望的，哪怕是要天上的星星，我也会答应你。

choice:13:0:1.text: The decoration took some doing on my part.
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 把圣古堂布置成这样可不容易
choice:13:0:1.male: The decoration took some doing on my part.
choice:13:0:1.female: The decoration took some doing on my part.

choice:13:1:2.text: I was up all night preparing this.
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 为了今天，昨晚我可没少忙活
choice:13:1:2.male: I was up all night preparing this.
choice:13:1:2.female: I was up all night preparing this.

say:0:1720768001:0.text: I have to prepare so many things...

say:1:1720770001:1.text: Princess Peggy, you're finally back! The Queen has... Your Highness, you seem... a little different.
say:1:1720770001:1.source_cn: 公主殿下，您终于回来了！王后陛下已经……哎？殿下，您看...

say:2:1720770002:1.text: Sorry for making you worried, Marge. I'll fill you in later, but now, I have an important task for you.
say:2:1720770002:1.source_cn: 玛格丽特，让你担心了。不过现在没时间叙旧了，我有很重要...

say:3:1720770003:1.text: Take this order slip to Susan's place and pick up the brooch. Thank her on my behalf.
say:3:1720770003:1.source_cn: 请你亲自去一趟苏珊婆婆那里，用这张提货单替我取回那枚订...

say:6:1720770005:1.text: Rowan, I'm entrusting this land deed to you. You know plenty of builders, don't you? I need you to engage the best one to build an orphanage on this land.
say:6:1720770005:1.source_cn: 罗万，这份下城区的地契交给你。秘银商会一定与不少建筑商...

say:7:1720770006:1.text: And... please share the news with the children at the temple.
say:7:1720770006:1.source_cn: 然后……希望你能替我把这个消息告诉教堂的孩子们。

say:8:1720770007:1.text: Got it... I'll get this done!
say:8:1720770007:1.source_cn: 我明白了……既然是公主的委托，秘银商会定当全力以赴。

say:10:1720770008:1.text: Gwyneth, could you make a trip to the Rusty Barrel Tavern? This invitation is meant for a minstrel there. Tell him it's the stage he deserves.
say:10:1720770008:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝，要麻烦你替我跑一趟锈桶酒馆，把这张剧院的邀请...

say:11:1720770009:1.text: I'm sure it'll make his day.
say:11:1720770009:1.source_cn: 我想，他见到邀请函一定会非常高兴的。

say:13:1720770010:1.text: And one more thing, when you see them, please pass along a message for me...
say:13:1720770010:1.source_cn: 还有，最重要的一件事——请各位在见到他们时，务必帮我带...

say:14:1720770011:1.text: Peggy lowers her voice and speaks solemnly. Marge, Rowan, and Gwyneth then set off to carry out their duties.
say:14:1720770011:1.source_cn: 佩吉压低声音，郑重地说出了那个特殊的邀请。玛格丽特、罗...

say:15:1720770012:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there's one last thing I need to do, and I hope you'll come with me.
say:15:1720770012:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there's one last thing I need to do, and I hope you'll come with me.
say:15:1720770012:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there's one last thing I need to do, and I hope you'll come with me.

choice_prompt:16:1720770012.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there's one last thing I need to do, and I hope you'll come with me.
choice_prompt:16:1720770012.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，还剩最后一件事，我希望你能陪我一起完成。
choice_prompt:16:1720770012.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there's one last thing I need to do, and I hope you'll come with me.
choice_prompt:16:1720770012.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there's one last thing I need to do, and I hope you'll come with me.

say:17:1720770013:1.text: Yes, and this time, I'll pay my respects to her son as Princess Peggy.
say:17:1720770013:1.source_cn: 是的，我要正式去祭拜那位年轻人，而这次去，是以耀光帝国...

choice:16:0:1.text: Are you heading to Vina Cemetery?
choice:16:0:1.male: Are you heading to Vina Cemetery?
choice:16:0:1.female: Are you heading to Vina Cemetery?

choice:16:1:2.text: Do you plan to meet that elderly lady?
choice:16:1:2.male: Do you plan to meet that elderly lady?
choice:16:1:2.female: Do you plan to meet that elderly lady?

say:1:1720773001:1.text: Good day, everyone. I'm Princess Peggy, here on behalf of the royal court to honor an unsung hero.
say:1:1720773001:1.source_cn: 诸位，我是耀光帝国的佩吉公主。今日，我以王室代表的身份...

say:2:1720773002:1.text: Here rests Julino, a young man gone too soon.
say:2:1720773002:1.source_cn: 在这里长眠的，是年轻的朱利诺。

say:3:1720773003:1.text: He held no noble title, nor was his name widely known, yet he defended our homeland with his young life during the Divine War twenty years ago...
say:3:1720773003:1.source_cn: 他没有显赫的爵位，也没有为人传颂的功勋，但他用自己年轻...

say:4:1720773004:1.text: ... He sacrificed himself for the peace of Savannah, leaving behind a grieving mother.
say:4:1720773004:1.source_cn: ……他带走了战火和伤痛，留下了赛凡纳的和平和心碎的母亲。

say:5:1720773005:1.text: The prosperity and peace we enjoy today were bought with countless lives like Julino's and the tears of their parents.
say:5:1720773005:1.source_cn: 我们如今拥有的繁华与安宁，并不是凭空而来的。它是用无数...

say:6:1720773006:1.text: Their names may not be etched in history, but their sacrifices form the foundation of our empire. To forget them is to forget our past.
say:6:1720773006:1.source_cn: 他们或许没有名字留在史书上，但他们才是耀光真正的基石。...

say:7:1720773007:1.text: Today, I stand here to show that the royal court remembers them. We will never forget.
say:7:1720773007:1.source_cn: 所以，我今天来到这里，不为别的，只为了告诉这位母亲，也...

say:8:1720773008:1.text: A hush falls over the crowd. Some lower their heads in mourning, while others quietly wipe away tears. Peggy's speech is simple, yet it tugs at everyone's heartstrings.
say:8:1720773008:1.source_cn: 人群中一片寂静，许多人都低下了头，也有人在悄悄抹眼泪。...

say:10:1720773009:0.text: The elderly woman looks up, her clouded eyes brimming with tears of gratitude.
say:10:1720773009:0.source_cn: 老妇人颤抖着抬起头，浑浊的眼中满是泪水与感激。

say:11:1720773010:0.text: Your Highness... Julino would be so happy to see this...
say:11:1720773010:0.source_cn: 殿下……朱利诺他……他在天上看着，一定也会很高兴的……

say:12:1720773011:1.text: Madam, my birthday banquet takes place this evening. May I have the honor of your presence?
say:12:1720773011:1.source_cn: 夫人，今晚是我的生日宴会。虽然有些冒昧，但我还是想请您...

say:13:1720773012:1.text: I want everyone in the empire to celebrate your selfless love for your son.
say:13:1720773012:1.source_cn: 我想让所有人都知道，能有您这样一位伟大的母亲，是耀光的荣幸。

say:14:1720773013:1.text: Your Highness, thank you so much... I'll be there.
say:14:1720773013:1.source_cn: 公主殿下，谢谢……谢谢您，我会去的。

say:0:1720774001:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm heading back to the palace to prepare for the banquet. See you tonight!
say:0:1720774001:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm heading back to the palace to prepare for the banquet. See you tonight!
say:0:1720774001:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm heading back to the palace to prepare for the banquet. See you tonight!

say:0:1720775001:0.text: Alright, time to head to the palace for Peggy's birthday banquet.
say:0:1720775001:0.source_cn: 时间差不多了，去皇宫参加佩吉的生日宴会吧。
say:0:1720775001:0.male: Alright, time to head to the palace for Peggy's birthday banquet.
say:0:1720775001:0.female: Alright, time to head to the palace for Peggy's birthday banquet.

say:0:1720776001:1.text: Is it true there are special guests tonight?
say:0:1720776001:1.source_cn: 听说今晚有特别的客人？

say:1:1720778002:1.text: I heard they were invited by the princess.
say:1:1720778002:1.source_cn: 听说那是公主邀请的客人

say:1:1720779001:1.text: There you are, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! *Whew*... Playing host is more exhausting than I imagined.
say:1:1720779001:1.male: There you are, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! *Whew*... Playing host is more exhausting than I imagined.
say:1:1720779001:1.female: There you are, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! *Whew*... Playing host is more exhausting than I imagined.

say:2:1720779002:1.text: Still, seeing everyone here... it feels wonderful. Let's check on them together! I want to make sure everyone's having a good time.
say:2:1720779002:1.source_cn: 不过，看到大家都在……这种感觉真好。快，陪我去看看他们...
say:2:1720779002:1.male: Still, seeing everyone here... it feels wonderful. Let's check on them together! I want to make sure everyone's having a good time.
say:2:1720779002:1.female: Still, seeing everyone here... it feels wonderful. Let's check on them together! I want to make sure everyone's having a good time.

say:3:1720780002:1.text: Oh, Susan, don't stand on ceremony! I was just chatting with a few duchesses, and they couldn't take their eyes off my brooch!
say:3:1720780002:1.source_cn: 苏珊婆婆，请不用多礼。刚才我戴着这枚胸针，好几位公爵夫...

say:4:1720780003:1.text: *Cough*... Your Highness, I'm so glad you like it. I was worried the stone hadn't been set quite as perfectly as it ought...
say:4:1720780003:1.source_cn: 咳咳……殿下，您不嫌弃就好。我本来还担心镶嵌得不够完美……

say:5:1720780004:1.text: It looks flawless to me. Everyone is admiring its beauty, and the credit is all yours.
say:5:1720780004:1.source_cn: 在我看来它已经足够完美了。您听，路过的宾客都在赞美它呢...

say:6:1720780005:1.text: How are you feeling now? Rowan mentioned you'd been working through your illness.
say:6:1720780005:1.source_cn: 我听罗万说了，您为了赶制这枚胸针，不惜带病工作，甚至还...

say:7:1720780006:1.text: Thank you for your concern, Your Highness. I received help from Magister Merlin... and a kind young lady when I visited the Mithril Consortium.
say:7:1720780006:1.source_cn: 多谢殿下挂念，我身子好多了。当时在商会，多亏了梅林大人...
say:7:1720780006:1.male: Thank you for your concern, Your Highness. I received help from Magister Merlin... and a kind young lady when I visited the Mithril Consortium.
say:7:1720780006:1.female: Thank you for your concern, Your Highness. I received help from Magister Merlin... and a kind young lady when I visited the Mithril Consortium.

say:8:1720780007:0.text: I'm not quite sure why, but the way that young lady spoke and cared for me... it reminds me of Your Highness.
say:8:1720780007:0.source_cn: 说来也怪，那位小姑娘虽然说话直了点，但那股子关心人的劲...

say:9:1720780008:0.text: Um... I imagine it's because we both wish the same thing—for you to be well and keep creating beautiful jewelry!
say:9:1720780008:0.source_cn: 那……一定是我和那个小姑娘很有缘分吧！我们都希望您能健...

say:10:1720780009:1.text: Your Highness... your recognition makes all my hard work worthwhile.
say:10:1720780009:1.source_cn: 殿下……能听到您这番话，过往的一切辛苦都值了。

say:11:1720780010:1.text: Please enjoy yourself and get plenty of rest! After all, that young lady and I both hope you recover soon.
say:11:1720780010:1.source_cn: 好啦，今晚您是我的贵宾。请务必多吃点好吃的，好好休息。...

say:1:1720781002:1.text: So many utensils... Which one am I supposed to use?

say:1:1720782001:0.text: Jenine, um... you see that silver tray? Will it break if I touch it?
say:1:1720782001:0.source_cn: 珍妮，那个……那个银色的盘子，能摸吗？会不会赔不起啊？

say:2:1720782002:1.text: Shh! Hands off! Just admire it with your eyes...
say:2:1720782002:1.source_cn: 嘘！别乱动！我们看看就行了……

say:3:1720782003:1.text: This place is so posh... Are we really allowed to be here? Will someone come and show us the door?
say:3:1720782003:1.source_cn: 这里太漂亮了……我们真的能待在这儿吗？会不会被赶出去啊？

say:4:1720782004:1.text: Rowan said Princess Peggy invited us... but where is she? People say she's very imposing... I'm a little scared.
say:4:1720782004:1.source_cn: 罗万哥哥说了，是公主殿下邀请我们的……可是，公主殿下在...

say:6:1720782005:1.source_cn: 谁说公主很凶的？我可听到了哦！

say:8:1720782007:1.text: Hey, you can relax around me. See the honey-glazed meatloaf, chilled fruit juice, and royal roasted turkey drumsticks? They were made especially for you!
say:8:1720782007:1.source_cn: 好啦，在我这里不用那么拘束。桌上的这些食物——流蜜黄金...

say:9:1720782008:1.text: I understand what you've suffered, and I'm relieved to say those dark days have passed... In the Lightbearer Empire, every child will have food, education, and a home.
say:9:1720782008:1.source_cn: 听说你们之前受了不少苦……以后不会了。在耀光，每一个孩...

say:10:1720782009:1.text: Your Highness... your voice sounds just like that kind girl who took us to the temple.
say:10:1720782009:1.source_cn: 公主姐姐……你的声音，和那个送我们去教堂的姐姐好像啊。

say:11:1720782010:1.text: I-Is that so? Maybe it's because... we both wish for you to have a happy childhood.
say:11:1720782010:1.source_cn: 是、是吗？可能是因为……我们都希望你们能开开心心地长大吧。

say:12:1720782011:1.text: Go on and dig in! I grant you special permission to enjoy the food with your hands! Eat however you please, and there's more food if you want!
say:12:1720782011:1.source_cn: 好啦，快吃吧！今晚本公主特许你们——不用刀叉，直接用手...

say:13:1720782012:1.text: Thank you, Your Highness! This meatloaf smells even better than the one in my dreams!
say:13:1720782012:1.source_cn: 嗯！谢谢公主姐姐！这里的肉饼……比我做梦梦到的还要香！

say:0:1720783001:1.text: As a somber yet soulful song drifts from the stage, silence settles over the hall.
say:0:1720783001:1.source_cn: 随着一阵苍凉而深情的琴声响起，宴会厅的一角渐渐安静了下来。

say:2:1720783002:0.text: "... Born before April's end, his blue eyes reflected the scenery of his homeland..."
say:2:1720783002:0.source_cn: “……他生在四月末尾，湛蓝的眼睛，映照着故乡的风景……”

say:3:1720783003:0.text: "... Fallen before the dawn, his fractured sword reborn as a star shining on..."
say:3:1720783003:0.source_cn: “……他倒在黎明之前，手中的断剑，化作了永恒的晨星……”

say:4:1720783004:0.text: Both nobles and servants alike pause in their tracks, entranced by the minstrel's voice.
say:4:1720783004:0.source_cn: 无论是端着酒杯的贵族，还是忙碌的侍从，都停下了动作，被...

say:6:1720783005:0.text: Amid the crowd, an elderly woman listens in silence, tears welling in her eyes as the sorrowful song unfolds.
say:6:1720783005:0.source_cn: 人群中，一位老妇人眼含热泪，静静地聆听着这如泣如诉的歌声。

say:8:1720783006:0.text: Your Highness, thank you for inviting me here. I told the minstrel Julino's story, and he wrote this song for me...
say:8:1720783006:0.source_cn: 殿下，感谢您让我来到这里。我只是向那位吟游诗人讲了朱利...

say:9:1720783007:0.text: His voice... is so full of emotion. I feel as though Julino is right here, telling me he didn't die for nothing.
say:9:1720783007:0.source_cn: 这歌声……真好。好像朱利诺正在我耳边说话，告诉我……他...

say:10:1720783008:0.text: Of course, he didn't. Just look around—we wouldn't be able to enjoy this banquet tonight if not for his sacrifice.
say:10:1720783008:0.source_cn: 他当然没有白白牺牲。您看，这满堂的灯火，人们脸上的笑容...

say:11:1720783009:1.text: This song shall stand as a remembrance of everything Julino has done for Savannah.
say:11:1720783009:1.source_cn: 从今往后，每当这首歌在赛凡纳响起，人们就会记起他的名字...

say:12:1720783010:1.text: I am... deeply grateful, Your Highness. This is the best gift I could have as his mother...
say:12:1720783010:1.source_cn: 谢谢……谢谢您，殿下。作为一个母亲，这是我能收到的……...

say:0:1720784001:0.text: Looks like we're done with the guests. Let's see how Rowan and Gwyneth are doing!
say:0:1720784001:0.source_cn: 客人接待得差不多了，我们去找罗万和格温妮丝聊聊吧！

say:3:1720785001:0.text: Tonight's banquet couldn't have gone better! I've never seen so many genuine smiles in the palace at once. Everyone, nobles and commoners alike, is truly happy.
say:3:1720785001:0.source_cn: 佩吉，今天的宴会很成功。我从没有见过王宫里有这么多真诚...

say:4:1720785002:0.text: Indeed! The little girl who used to boss people around has finally learned to care for others!
say:4:1720785002:0.source_cn: 是啊，真没想到我能亲眼看到这一天。那个稍不顺心就拿欠条...

say:5:1720785003:0.text: I suppose I can no longer treat you as a child. Truth be told, I miss your mischievous spirit, Peggy.
say:5:1720785003:0.source_cn: 看来，以后再想把她当小孩是不行咯。某种意义上，我还挺怀...

say:6:1720785004:0.text: Hmph! Don't start acting like you're the mature one! I've always been sensible, but you were just too dense to notice!
say:6:1720785004:0.source_cn: 哼！少在这里装成熟！本公主以前也很懂事好不好！只是你这...

say:7:1720785005:0.text: I can be great if I want to. Impressive, huh?
say:7:1720785005:0.source_cn: 再说了，我只是……稍微认真了一点点而已！就一点点！怎么...

say:8:1720785006:0.text: Yes, you're absolutely right. Looks like the Wisdom Spell actually worked.
say:8:1720785006:0.source_cn: 是是是，效果好极了。看来那个能让人一夜长大的术式，还真...

say:9:1720785007:0.text: Speaking of which, I had a hard time holding back my laughter when you actually believed that kind of magic existed, haha!
say:9:1720785007:0.source_cn: 不过说起来，你竟然真的相信会有这种魔法？我当时可是忍笑...

say:10:1720785008:0.text: Y-You obviously fell for it just as much, especially since it came from <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Don't deny it!
say:10:1720785008:0.source_cn: 你、你！你当时明明也信以为真，被<style=stre...
say:10:1720785008:0.male: Y-You obviously fell for it just as much, especially since it came from <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Don't deny it!
say:10:1720785008:0.female: Y-You obviously fell for it just as much, especially since it came from <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Don't deny it!

say:11:1720785009:0.text: Whatever the case, you're the star of the night, Peggy. Happy birthday!
say:11:1720785009:0.source_cn: 无论如何，今晚属于你，佩吉。我要向你郑重送上我的祝福—...

say:12:1720785010:0.text: I say this every year, but... this year is different. Happy birthday, Peggy!
say:12:1720785010:0.source_cn: 虽然每年都要说一次，但今年……确实不太一样。佩吉，生日快乐！

choice_prompt:13:1720785010.text: I say this every year, but... this year is different. Happy birthday, Peggy!
choice_prompt:13:1720785010.source_cn: 虽然每年都要说一次，但今年……确实不太一样。佩吉，生日快乐！

say:14:1720785011:0.text: Why is everyone being so nice to me all of a sudden? You're making me shy... I couldn't have done this without your help.
say:14:1720785011:0.source_cn: 你们突然这样，我都要不好意思了……这一切，不只是我的功...

say:15:1720785012:0.text: Rowan, your errand boy duties may be over, but I'm going shopping tomorrow, and you're coming with me! Consider this... a special reward for your good behavior!
say:15:1720785012:0.source_cn: 还有，罗万，虽然你的跟班期限到了，但明天要是我想去逛街...

say:16:1720785013:0.text: ... Seems like I have no way out of this. As you wish, Your Highness.
say:16:1720785013:0.source_cn: ……看来我是逃不掉了。遵命，我的公主殿下。

choice_prompt:17:1720785013.text: ... Seems like I have no way out of this. As you wish, Your Highness.
choice_prompt:17:1720785013.source_cn: ……看来我是逃不掉了。遵命，我的公主殿下。

say:18:1720785014:0.text: Here's to Peggy, who has finally grown up!

say:19:1720785015:0.text: Here's to Peggy, the brave princess!

say:20:1720785016:0.text: Huh? I don't know what to say!
say:20:1720785016:0.source_cn: 哎？敬……我可没有提前想好词啊！

say:21:1720785017:0.text: Well then... here's to my amazing friends!
say:21:1720785017:0.source_cn: 那就敬，我可爱的友人们吧！

choice:17:0:1.text: Now, to end this night on a perfect note...
choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 那么，作为生日的完美结局——
choice:17:0:1.male: Now, to end this night on a perfect note...
choice:17:0:1.female: Now, to end this night on a perfect note...

choice:17:1:2.text: Let us all raise our glasses in celebration...
choice:17:1:2.male: Let us all raise our glasses in celebration...
choice:17:1:2.female: Let us all raise our glasses in celebration...

choice:13:1:2.text: May you always be as happy as you are tonight.
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 希望你永远像今晚一样开心
choice:13:1:2.male: May you always be as happy as you are tonight.
choice:13:1:2.female: May you always be as happy as you are tonight.

say:4:1720729001:0.text: That poor minstrel looks hungry. Should we help him?
say:4:1720729001:0.source_cn: 那是个吟游诗人吧？他是不是也饿着肚子？我们能不能帮帮他？

say:5:1720729002:0.text: Prin... Lady Penny, hold on. Your heart's in the right place, but you'll need the right approach so you don't hurt his pride.
say:5:1720729002:0.source_cn: 佩……佩小姐，等等。帮忙也得讲究方法，成年人的自尊心，...

say:6:1720729003:0.text: I know! I'll be tactful about it. Just watch me!
say:6:1720729003:0.source_cn: 我知道！我会很礼貌地提供帮助的。看我的吧！

say:8:1720729004:0.text: Peggy steadies herself with a deep breath before moving toward the minstrel...
say:8:1720729004:0.source_cn: 佩吉深吸了一口气，走上前去——

say:10:1720729005:0.text: Rude! How rude! Fine wine should be enjoyed with music and poetry, not tainted by the vulgar stink of money!
say:10:1720729005:0.source_cn: 粗鲁！真是粗鲁！美酒应当搭配音乐和诗歌，而不是铜臭味！

say:11:1720729006:0.text: May I speak to you for a second, sir?

say:12:1720729007:0.text: I-I really admire your talent. If you don't mind, I'd like to pay for your drinks... Consider it my way of supporting your art.
say:12:1720729007:0.source_cn: 我、我很欣赏您的才华，如果您不介意的话，我想替您支付酒...

say:13:1720729008:0.text: Pay for my drinks? Supporting my art?

say:14:1720729009:0.text: Young lady, your courtesy is admirable, but I can tell it's driven by pity.
say:14:1720729009:0.source_cn: 小姑娘，你的礼仪无可挑剔，但我听得出来，你的举动只不过...

say:16:1720729011:0.text: Please, spare me your kindness. I don't need any handouts, no matter what you call them.
say:16:1720729011:0.source_cn: 收起你的好意吧。我的才华不需要施舍，哪怕是包装得再精美...

say:17:1720729012:0.text: Just enjoy my performance if you really like what I do.
say:17:1720729012:0.source_cn: 如果你真的欣赏我的才华，就该安静地站在这里，听我唱完这首歌。

say:18:1720729013:0.text: Should my voice move you, leave me a coin. If not, you're free to walk away, guilt-free.
say:18:1720729013:0.source_cn: 要是我的歌声打动了你，我很欢迎你把那枚该死的金币放进我...

say:19:1720729014:0.text: That's what you do if you respect me as a minstrel, not paying me off before I've even sung a note.
say:19:1720729014:0.source_cn: 那才是一个吟游诗人应得的尊严，而不是像现在这样，还没开...

say:20:1720729015:0.source_cn: 对……对不起。我只是想帮忙……

say:21:1720729016:0.text: Then give me your full attention. That's all I ask. You're listening to the finest minstrel in all of Savannah!
say:21:1720729016:0.source_cn: 想帮忙？那就竖起耳朵认真听吧。这可是全赛凡纳最好的吟游...

say:27:1720729017:0.text: ... From a faraway land, a young man sets forth. His old lute is his oar, he carries nothing more...
say:27:1720729017:0.source_cn: ……他从千里之外的村庄启程，一把旧琴是他的舟桨……

say:28:1720729018:0.text: ... He arrives in the royal capital, radiant and surreal. Mistaking its splendor for a haven ideal...
say:28:1720729018:0.source_cn: ……他来到了纸醉金迷的王都，以为这里是梦中的故乡……

say:29:1720729019:0.text: ... The crowd drifts past, unmoved by his song. Like rivers they rush, relentless, headstrong...
say:29:1720729019:0.source_cn: ……人群流水般匆匆经过，没有人驻足听他歌唱……

say:30:1720729020:0.text: ... Yet the wind lingers softly, the birds sing along...
say:30:1720729020:0.source_cn: ……人群流水般迢迢路过，风和鸟儿在听他唱歌……

say:31:1720729021:0.text: ... They lift up his spirit, and show he belongs...
say:31:1720729021:0.source_cn: ……风儿为他温柔地停留，鸟儿为了他鸣鸣啾啾……

say:32:1720729022:0.text: ... O young minstrel, do not grieve, so long as your strings still breathe...
say:32:1720729022:0.source_cn: ……年轻的吟游诗人啊，不要忧伤，只要琴弦未断……

say:33:1720729023:0.text: ... Simply savor the wandering free, for freedom itself is melody...

narration:34:1720729024:0.text: The minstrel wraps up his performance...

narration:39:1702072203:0.text: When the song ends, the children clap with genuine delight. Peggy drops a gold coin into the minstrel's instrument case.
narration:39:1702072203:0.source_cn: 一曲表演结束后，孩子们发自内心地为吟游诗人鼓掌，佩吉把...

narration:40:1702072202:0.text: The minstrel begins to play his instrument and sing.
narration:40:1702072202:0.source_cn: 吟游诗人开始弹奏起了音乐，唱起了歌。

narration:41:1702072201:0.text: On your way to the temple, you see a bartender throw a ragged minstrel out of the tavern.
narration:41:1702072201:0.source_cn: 在前往教堂的路上，你们看到酒保把一个衣衫褴褛的吟游诗人...
